text:
alex: Quick heads-up — proposing to unpin runtime v3.2.1 for canary tonight at 23:00 UTC. Deploybot will flip cohort A to the unpinned path. Rationale: kernel regression fixed, we need production verification. Rollback criteria: error rate > 2% OR p99 latency > 500ms for 5m window. Any blockers?
maria: LGTM. Tagging QA to run longseq + perf. Which cohort size and region?
alex: Cohort A = 5% traffic, EU only. Hold for 1h at 5% then ramp to 25% if stable. I'll draft release note.
jun: Can we add an SLO alert and a simple runbook? I can add a dashboard query and hook it into the deploy-bot alert. Suggestion: if error_rate_unpinned > 0.02 OR p99_unpinned > 500 then auto-pin back and notify #eng-oncall.
sam: Quick SDK note — python SDK 0.12.0 changed kv-cache header name in requests; compatibility tests passed but we should call it out in the release notes. Also remind docs team to add a short migration note.
deploy-bot: scheduled: unpin runtime v3.2.1 -> cohort A at 23:00 UTC. Planned command: `deploybot unpin --runtime v3.2.1 --cohort A --rollout 5 --hold 3600 --auto-pin-on-sla true --sla error>0.02,p99>500`
maria: I'll run the longseq job now. Test command: ```make test-longseq COHORT=A TARGET=eu --duration=30m``` ETA ~40m. Will post artifacts. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks — I'll push the release note draft to the changelog draft: https://redwood.internal/changelog/v3.2.1-draft and include the SDK compatibility blurb. Also adding the rollback playbook step summary in the runbook doc.
jun: Added the dashboard query and wired an alert to deploy-bot. Also created a lightweight runbook snippet: ```
if alert.triggered:
  deploybot.pin(runtime="v3.2.1", reason="auto-sla")
  post_to_channel("#eng-oncall", "runtime pinned back due to SLA breach")
```
sam: One more note — dedicated fleets remain pinned on customer committed versions; this only impacts hosted canary traffic. Private customers unaffected.
maria: Longseq results look clean so far, no regressions in KV cache path. Uploading logs: https://artifacts.internal/longseq/8023456789/results.tar.gz
alex: OK let's proceed as planned. Deploybot will post status messages. If anyone sees anything off call out immediately. :rocket:
